# Set a single-source virtual view folder before opening its native view

_createView assigns dbView.viewFolder for a single-folder virtual folder before dbView.open. That lets native open restore persisted state from the virtual folder, rather than the underlying real folder. Search terms can require setting viewFolder again after open. Preserve this order when changing the wrapper-to-native view boundary.

Scope: mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs.
